effects: The signer sends exactly `assets` USDG to the vault (safeTransferFrom asset, msg.sender, vault).
The vault mints bbqUSDG shares to onBehalf; the share amount comes from previewDeposit at the current rate, with no minimum.
Fee shares go to the fee recipients first through accrueInterest, which sets the share price the signer gets.
formats.shown: Deposit 0.01 USDG for <onBehalf>, with the share ticker bbqUSDG and the share recipient shown; the number of shares received is not shown.

findings.title: deposit does not show how many bbqUSDG shares arrive; the vault rate in storage decides it.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.deposit: `uint256 shares = previewDeposit(assets); enter(assets, shares, onBehalf);` No minShares parameter. Case 0: 0.010000010 bbqUSDG in to the signer, and the screen shows only 'Share ticker: bbqUSDG'.
findings.fix: None in the descriptor. The share amount is not in the calldata.

cases.notes: The screen shows the USDG out (0.01) exactly. The bbqUSDG in shows its ticker and recipient but no amount, and calldata cannot give one.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: The vault burns bbqUSDG shares from onBehalf; the number comes from previewWithdraw (rounded up), with no maximum.
When msg.sender is not onBehalf, the call spends the signer's share allowance from onBehalf.
The vault sends exactly `assets` USDG to receiver.
formats.shown: Withdraw exactly 200000 USDG to <receiver>, with the owner shown; nothing says that bbqUSDG shares are burned or how many.

findings.title: withdraw does not say that bbqUSDG shares are burned from the owner.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.exit: `deleteShares(onBehalf, shares);` Case 2: the signer loses 199919.79 bbqUSDG, but the screen fields are only 'Withdraw exactly', 'To' and 'Owner'.
findings.fix: Rename the 'Owner' label to 'Burn bbqUSDG shares from'. Optionally add a constant field with the vaultTicker.

findings.title: withdraw has no cap on the shares burned; the vault rate in storage sets the number.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.withdraw: `uint256 shares = previewWithdraw(assets);` No maxShares parameter exists.

cases.notes: The screen shows the 200000 USDG in, with the right recipient. The reader guessed that shares leave, but the screen gives no share asset or amount.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: The vault burns exactly `shares` bbqUSDG from onBehalf, and spends the signer's share allowance when the signer is not onBehalf.
The vault sends USDG to receiver; the amount comes from previewRedeem at the current rate, with no minimum.
formats.shown: Redeem N bbqUSDG to <receiver>, with the owner shown; the screen does not name the USDG received or give its amount.

findings.title: redeem never names USDG as the asset the receiver gets.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.exit: `SafeERC20Lib.safeTransfer(asset, receiver, assets);` The redeem fields are only 'Shares to redeem', 'To' and 'Owner'. Case 3: the signer receives 380961.92 USDG. The reader wrote 'likely USDG' and listed the paid-out token as unsure.
findings.fix: Add {"label":"Receive asset","format":"raw","value":"$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"}. Change the interpolatedIntent to 'Redeem {#.shares} for USDG to {#.receiver}'.

findings.title: redeem has no minimum for the USDG received; the vault rate in storage sets it.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.redeem: `uint256 assets = previewRedeem(shares);` No minAssets parameter exists.

cases.notes: The screen shows the bbqUSDG out exactly. The USDG in has neither its asset nor its amount on screen.

effects: The signer sends USDG to the vault; the amount comes from previewMint (rounded up) at the current rate, with no maximum.
The vault mints exactly `shares` bbqUSDG to onBehalf.
formats.shown: Mint 1 bbqUSDG for <onBehalf>, with a constant 'Deposit asset: USDG'; the screen does not say how much USDG leaves the wallet.

findings.title: The mint intent and sentence do not say that the signer pays USDG for the shares.
findings.evidence: Descriptor mint: intent 'Mint', interpolatedIntent 'Mint {#.shares} for {#.onBehalf}'. VaultV2.enter: `SafeERC20Lib.safeTransferFrom(asset, msg.sender, address(this), assets);` Case 1: the signer pays 1 USDG.
findings.fix: Change the intent to 'Deposit USDG for shares'. Change the interpolatedIntent to 'Deposit USDG to mint {#.shares} for {#.onBehalf}'.

findings.title: mint has no cap on the USDG it takes; the vault rate in storage sets the amount.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.mint: `uint256 assets = previewMint(shares); enter(assets, shares, onBehalf);` No maxAssets parameter exists. Case 1: 1 USDG out and no amount on screen.

cases.notes: The screen names USDG as the deposit asset but gives no amount, so the reader knew the asset and the direction but not the 1 USDG. The shares go to 0xdead, which is not the signer, and the screen shows that correctly.
